summary.text: Bob Freeman is the Democratic state representative for Tennessee House District 56, part of Davidson County in Nashville, who took office in November 2018 and is the incumbent on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
He works in real estate and has served on several environmental and sustainability boards.

paragraphs.text: Freeman was born in Nashville and earned a bachelor's degree from Middle Tennessee State University and a master's degree from Lipscomb University.
The legislature's biography lists his occupation as real estate, and Ballotpedia describes his career experience as vice president at Freeman Webb.

He has served on the boards of the Tennessee Environmental Council, the Southern Alliance for Clean Energy and the U.S. Green Building Council's Market Leadership Advisory Board, and on the Nashville Homeless Commission.
Freeman has been a member of the House since the 111th General Assembly.
The House website lists him as a member of the Calendar & Rules Committee and the Ethics Committee.
